test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Exploistation"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the correct spelling:

__
 
• **Exploitation **- the use of something in order to get an advantage from it

 
 
• ***Eg***. Britain's *exploitation* of its natural gas reserves began after the Second World War.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's learn some other word meanings:

 
• **Immigration -** the act of someone coming to live in a different country

 
 
• ***Eg.*** There are strict limits on *immigration* (into the country).
 
 
 
• **Administrator -** the arrangements and tasks needed to control the operation of a plan or organization
 
 
• ***Eg***. Teachers complain that more of their time is taken up with* administration* than with teaching.
 
 
 
• **Admission **- the act of agreeing that something is true, especially unwillingly
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Her silence was taken as an *admission* of guilt/defeat.
